title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Find the best Auckland gyms by suburb, price and commuter options. Compare gym memberships and prices.
intro: Auckland has a wide range of gyms to choose from, with prices starting from $10 per week. With so many options, it can be hard to decide which gym is best for you. In this guide, we'll compare prices and options across different suburbs and areas of Auckland.

sections.heading: Auckland CBD Gyms
sections.body: The Auckland CBD has a high concentration of gyms, with many options to choose from. Some popular gyms in the area include Les Mills, City Fitness and Anytime Fitness. Prices in the CBD tend to be higher than in other areas, with Les Mills starting at $34.95 per week and City Fitness starting at $29.95 per week.

sections.heading: Suburban Gyms
list: North Shore: F45 Training ($60 per week, 12-month contract)
West Auckland: Fitzone ($24.95 per week, no contract)
South Auckland: Jetts ($14.95 per week, no contract)
East Auckland: Anytime Fitness ($19.95 per week, no contract)

sections.heading: Gym Membership Deals
sections.body: Many gyms in Auckland offer discounts and promotions for new members. For example, Les Mills is currently offering a 7-day free trial, while City Fitness is offering a $0 joining fee for new members who sign up on a 12-month contract.

cta.text: Compare Auckland gym prices and memberships

sections.heading: Conclusion
sections.body: With so many gyms to choose from in Auckland, it's worth doing your research to find the best option for you. Consider factors such as price, location, contract term and the type of equipment and classes on offer. You can compare prices and memberships from different gyms on our website.

sections.heading: Find Your Nearest Gym
sections.body: To find your nearest gym, simply enter your suburb or postcode on our website. We have a comprehensive list of gyms across Auckland, including their prices, contract terms and facilities.
